shortDescription: User profile overview view with a GitHub-style dark desktop layout.
fullDescription: Implements the user-profile-overview view in its default state as a full-width desktop profile page with a global dark header, icon-and-text profile navigation tabs, a left identity column, a two-column grid of popular repository cards, a contribution graph with selectable year buttons and contribution settings, and a contribution activity heading. The view exposes a state prop for supported screen states and keeps visible controls such as search, tabs, dropdowns, year selectors, links, and buttons interactive with local presentational state.
